title: Linear Issue Event Weekly Cycle Age Trend
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=linear:issue cycle_age_days=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(cycle_age_days) as avg_duration, max(cycle_age_days) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst cycle age for Linear issue event events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture cycle_age_days on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average cycle age with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It finds whether Linear issue event tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
